correctness.rationale: All parameters n≥3, p∈(0,1), threshold s≥1 and m∈[0,n-1] are quantified, including zero-length components. Independent-edge percolation coupling, exact finite small-component counts, positive difference (s−1)p^s for competing regimes, strict discrete convexity of pair-connectivity expectation, and exact sharp crossover at n=5 prove all statements. VERIFY.py independently passed 529 exact-rational cases; finite tests corroborate but do not prove universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: Protecting a path contact network with one dose and asking for the chance of at least s infections is a canonical exact stochastic-epidemic decision. The complete, p-independent optimal-place classification exposes a sharp qualitative conflict between expected size and probability of secondary transmission, beginning at exactly five nodes; no vaccine site first-order dominates all thresholds. This is a meaningful structural boundary and reproducible benchmark, not an arbitrary cutoff or brute-force restatement.
